$comment: ADR-410: tilesets for ADR-409's sloped ground shapes (ramps + wedges, per ground material x season). The atlases have NO image files of their own: their pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/task410-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URLs, 1x + @2x pages, the vehicles/atlas.ts pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at the matching season's real ground atlas (gt_<season>_p0, 15 cols of 68x52) only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is a plain grid (frame() math): 15 cols x 4 rows of 68x52, frame = materialIndex*8 + shapeIndex (material order = groundArt GROUND_PRIORITY: rock, sand, dirt, mud, forest, grass, snow; shape 0-3 = ramp downhill dirs 0-3, 4-7 = wedge low corners 0-3). Valley/peak/stepped keep a flat top and need no art.
name: survivaz-task410
